text: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) helps identify negative thought patterns. In Hinglish: 'Apne thoughts ko observe karo — kya woh sach mein sach hain?'
Grounding technique 5-4-3-2-1: Name 5 things you see, 4 you can touch, 3 you hear, 2 you smell, 1 you taste. Helps with anxiety and panic.
Box breathing: 4 counts in, 4 hold, 4 out, 4 hold. Activates parasympathetic nervous system. Good for acute stress.
Behavioral activation: Jab kuch acha nahi lagta, choti choti activities karo. Walk pe jao, kisi se baat karo. Depression mein motivation action ke baad aati hai, pehle nahi.
Validation first: Before any advice, acknowledge feelings. 'Yeh sach mein bahut mushkil hai' is more helpful than any coping tip.
Sleep hygiene for Indian context: Phone screen 1 hour pehle band karo, fixed time pe sona, exam stress mein bhi 7 hours minimum.
Journaling: Apne feelings likhna — paper pe, phone pe, kuch bhi. Externalize karne se brain processing better hoti hai.
Progressive Muscle Relaxation: Start from toes, tense for 5 seconds, release. Move up to face. Good for body tension from chronic stress.
Mindfulness for beginners: Just notice breath. In, out. When mind wanders, bring back. 5 minutes daily. Koi special position nahi chahiye.
Social support activation: Akela feel karte waqt, ek aadmi ko message karo — sirf 'hi' bhi chalega. Connection ke liye pehla step.
